Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying requirements for pedestrians walking along roadways.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to pedestrians walking along roadways; and amendingRCW 46.61.250.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.61.250 and 1990 c 241 s 6 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Where sidewalks are provided it is unlawful for any pedestrianto walk or otherwise move along and upon an adjacent roadway. Wheresidewalks are provided but wheelchair access is not available,((disabled)) persons with disabilities who require such access may walkor otherwise move along and upon an adjacent roadway until they reachan access point in the sidewalk. (2) Where sidewalks are not provided, any pedestrian walking orotherwise moving along and upon a highway shall, when practicable, walkor move only on the left side of the roadway or its shoulder facingtraffic which may approach from the opposite direction ((and uponmeeting an oncoming vehicle shall move clear of the roadway)).
